title: CellWatch QC: auditable image triage for organ-on-a-chip workflows
subtitle: A local-first, CPU-only microscopy quality gate with interpretable evidence and reproducible stress testing
summary: CellWatch QC processes grayscale microscopy fields into object measurements, interpretable focus/contrast/exposure features, overlays, and a bounded quality-triage score. It is designed as an early review queue for OoC image pipelines, not as a diagnosis or biological claim. The public BBBC001v1 smoke test reports count MAE 32.4 objects/image and MAPE 8.71%; a separate synthetic stress test validates the software's response to controlled blur and exposure failures.
submission_channel: Kaggle Writeup UI; final Submit action requires an authenticated browser session

integrity_notes: Synthetic metrics are explicitly software stress-test metrics, not biological validation.
The QC score is a triage heuristic, not a probability of disease or treatment response.
No private OoC data, patient data, paid API, or proprietary model is required.
